rationale: INV-3310 matches the prior paid INV-3221 on vendor, PO and amount, but carries a distinct non-overlapping service period (March vs February 2026), so under clause 8.1 it is a legitimate recurring retainer charge, not a duplicate. PO-4408 is a SERVICES PO, so the absence of a goods receipt is not a defect (clause 1). Price and quantity match the blanket PO exactly, and recomputed tax at 7.5% of $4,800.00 is $360.00, equal to the billed figure (clause 5). Net payable $5,160.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
